Just bought a GoPro and need advice on mounting

I tried mine in a few places but the key is anywhere mounted to the frame is the most stable. I made a custom bracket for my forward control mount (I have mids) and I used the clamp at one point on the bracket for my passenger pegs. You may end up having to just make something so you can bolt it up somewhere. Good luck and share your successes/failures with us so folks can avoid any hang ups you run into.

Fair warning, I lost my Go Pro when I had it on my forwards bracket by scraping it off against the ground. heh.
